---
title: "check-python-qmd-chunks.yml"
---

Diff-scoped check that lints the Python chunks of the `.qmd` files
a pull request changes, with the repository's Ruff configuration.
The lab's Python style is an amendment of Google's guide,
and its Ruff configuration is `python/ruff.toml` in `Morrison-Lab/psc`.

The chunks of one `.qmd` file share a Python session,
so the check joins them in document order and lints them together.
It reports each finding at its line in the `.qmd` file.
Chunks that sit inside a callout or a list item are dedented first,
and a closing fence may be longer than its opener.

The check ignores the rules that a chunk of a page cannot satisfy:
missing docstrings, imports after code, unsorted imports,
a bare expression that shows a value, a trailing semicolon after a plot call,
undefined names that an earlier chunk defines, and unused imports.
It does not run the formatter.

With no base to diff against, the check skips with a warning
unless `whole-tree` is `true`.
It fails on a finding by default.

## Inputs

| Input | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `config` | `ruff.toml` | Path to the Ruff configuration |
| `globs` | `*.qmd` | Git pathspecs of tracked files to check (recursive) |
| `fail` | `true` | Fail on a finding; `false` warns |
| `whole-tree` | `false` | Lint every matching file, to measure a corpus |
| `python-version` | `3.x` | Python version |

## Usage

Copy `examples/check-python-qmd-chunks.yml` to
`.github/workflows/check-python-qmd-chunks.yml`,
and copy `python/ruff.toml` from `Morrison-Lab/psc` to the repository root.
